answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 10102 Country: India Title: Does the Wadhu gets damage if the person catches the sight of the Satar of some body? If it is true, what's about the women working with gents, as they generally wear garments with short sleeves, deep neck etc. and these parts include their satar. Is the same valid for pictures on TV. Question: Does the Wadhu gets damage if the person catches the sight of the Satar of some body? If it is true, what's about the women working with gents, as they generally wear garments with short sleeves, deep neck etc. and these parts include their satar. Is the same valid for pictures on TV. Answer ID: 10102 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 17/17=D/1429) The wudhu does not break by catching the sight of one?s satr (hidden body parts). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
